firstRun.title: Getting Started
firstRun.step1: Download the latest winrate & synergy data from Windrun.io — the overlay shows no recommendations without it.
firstRun.step2: Click 'Activate Overlay' below before you queue for an Ability Draft match.
firstRun.step3: On the draft screen, press Ctrl+Shift+S (or click 'Initial Scan' in the top-right overlay controls).
